jobs.title: Director of Enterprise Sales (New Business)
jobs.description:
**Take your career to new heights with Loopio!**
================================================

Loopio is seeking a proven **Director of Enterprise Sales** to lead our team into its next chapter of growth. If you're a proven sales leader who consistently beats quota, builds high\-performing teams, and thrives in fast\-moving, results\-driven environments, we want to talk. Reporting directly to the VP of Sales, you’ll shape the company's strategic direction. You’ll lead an existing team of Account Executives and work closely with leaders across Loopio to achieve our ambitious growth targets in the Enterprise segment (organizations with over 2,500 employees).

 *Note: This is an existing vacancy on the team*

  


**What You’ll Be Doing**
========================

* **Revenue**


	+ Ultimately, you are responsible for acquiring new customers, and achieving our revenue targets
	+ Continually create initiatives to optimize win rates, opportunity generation, deal velocity, and deal size
	+ Partner with the Marketing Team to explore and unlock new revenue opportunities, including new markets and industry segments
* **Team Management:**


	+ Oversee a rapidly growing team of Enterprise sellers
	+ Evolve and scale team structure, management hierarchy, and communication mechanisms
	+ Empower the team to achieve greater focus and efficiency by exploring and implementing strategic role specialization.
* **Talent Acquisition, Development \& Coaching:**


	+ **Build Your A\-Team:** Partner with our Talent Experience team to design and execute a rigorous interview process to attract and hire seasoned enterprise sales talent and high\-potential future stars. Be an active participant in recruiting, from leveraging your network to closing top candidates.
	+ **Accelerate Performance:** Optimize the onboarding and continuous training programs to decrease ramp\-up time and ensure every team member is equipped to excel.
	+ **Lead from the Front:** Roll up your sleeves to actively coach your team through participating in calls, reviewing deal strategy, and providing actionable feedback using tools like Gong and Lattice.
* **Forecasting \& Reporting**


	+ **Forecast with Precision:** Work with the Senior Leadership Team to set ambitious targets, develop accurate sales forecasts, and report on progress to the company and the Board of Directors.
	+ **Embrace Data:** Make data\-driven decisions the standard across the sales organization, using analytics to identify opportunities and mitigate risks.
* **Culture**


	+ Foster and scale a culture of discipline, continuous learning, competitiveness, collaboration, and celebrating success — what’s missing?
	+ **Champion Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Foster a strong, collaborative relationship with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure our GTM strategy is cohesive and our sales team is set up for success.
	+ Actively work to keep a pulse on the engagement, challenges, and well\-being of your team
* **Research \& Awareness**


	+ Work with other Loopio leaders to monitor trends in customers, market, and competitive landscape
	+ Ensure strong alignment between Product Management and Sales to set your team up for success
	+ Keep a pulse on trends, new tools, and best practices in SaaS software sales
* **AI \& Automation:** Drive the adoption of AI tools and automated workflows across the team to accelerate pipeline generation, enhance account intelligence, and optimize deal execution and coaching.

  

**What You’ll Bring to the Team**
=================================

* 10\+ years in B2B software sales, with a focus in new business acquisition
* 3\+ years in B2B Enterprise SaaS software leadership (Director level and above)
* Experience leading a team of Enterprise Account Executives
* Track record of setting and exceeding targets
* Deep analytical abilities and metrics\-driven approach
* Strong understanding of the RFP response process and the challenges that companies face
* Well\-defined leadership style that can be articulated clearly
* Experience with MEDDPICC and Command of the Message would be ideal
* Relevant Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a technical or business function
* Strong assets:


	+ Experience selling to Sales and Marketing organizations
	+ History of published thought leadership
	+ Experience in scaling a sales team and contributing to organizational growth from $50M to $100M ARR.

  

**Where You’ll Work**
---------------------

* *We are currently only looking for candidates who reside in the Greater Toronto Area and surrounding areas and can access our co\-working space in Downtown Toronto for the occasional Team get\-together.*
* Loopio is a remote\-first workplace because we recognize the advantages of working flexibly. We are HQ’d in Canada, with established hub regions around the world where we hire from.
* Our employees (or Loopers, as we call ourselves!) live and work in Canada (British Columbia and Ontario), US, India (specifically in Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Bengaluru), and London.
* The majority of our team is based in ON and BC, which means these employees live and work remotely within a 300km radius of Toronto (within Ontario) and Vancouver (Within BC).
* We offer flexible co\-working locations available to Loopers in ON and BC. Those based in ON have the option of working out of our convenient co\-working space located in the heart of Downtown Toronto and a 12\-minute walk from Union Station. BC Loopers have the option to work centrally in Vancouver. It is whatever works best for you!
* You’ll collaborate with your teams virtually across the UK, India, and North America (we’re just a Zoom call and Slack message away!) with core sync hours and focus time for headsdown work during the workday
* We encourage asynchronous collaboration to effectively work as a global \#OneTeam!

  

**Why You’ll Working at Loopio**
--------------------------------

* Your manager supports your development by providing ongoing feedback

jobs.title: Director, Security Architecture
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

**Job Description:**

**Role Summary**

  

You will represent the Security Architecture team across our enterprise architecture and technology community, shaping how security is designed into everything we build including the AI systems now reaching production.  



  

This is a senior, influence\-led role. You will prioritise the strategic concepts and capability sets that matter most, align security to the architecture process and the NIST framework, and advance technology modernisation and defense\-in\-depth across multiple clouds and on Prem.  



  

You will set direction for a substantial security technology stack including: cloud security posture and workload protection, endpoint detection and response, SIEM, secrets and privileged access management, data protection, application security and perimeter defense and make strategic decisions on the future of the technology stack  



  

**What will you do?**

  

* Partner with global domain architects to review enterprise architecture patterns and guardrails, ensuring security is designed in rather than retrofitted.
* Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, providing technical and thought leadership through proofs of concept and business cases that demonstrate value.
* Represent security technology and capability strategy at senior executive forums and enterprise technology review boards.
* Provide architecture and design expertise on enterprise projects and security initiatives, including cross\-domain functions, and certify domains in line with architecture governance.
* Lead the strategic evolution of security capabilities with a zero\-trust\-first approach, working alongside delivery teams.
* Define the security architecture for AI adoption covering AI and agentic systems, the data that feeds them, and the platforms that host them. This includes model and agent governance, AI security posture management, data\-classification controls for training and inference, guardrails against prompt injection and model misuse, and secure\-by\-design patterns for AI\-enabled products.
* Set a modernised approach to security tooling, services and capability sets, focused on technical feasibility across emerging technologies, controls and functions.
Drive multi\-cloud consistency, ensuring controls, telemetry and posture management extend uniformly across all cloud providers rather than clustering around the best\-covered one.  
* 

  

**What will you need to succeed?**

  

**Experience**
--------------

* Minimum 7–10 years in information security architecture, engineering and design.
* Proven ability to navigate complex organisations across the security, network, infrastructure and global architecture stack.
* Proven experience migrating and upgrading core security technologies as part of an evolving security and infrastructure stack, including API security, web filtering, cloud security, email security and endpoint security.
Experience managing third\-party security service providers in delivering security services.  
* 

  

**Technical depth**
-------------------

* Strong knowledge of core security domains: endpoint, cloud, infrastructure, perimeter and data protection.
* Multi\-cloud security architecture across at least two major providers, with an appreciation of how native controls and third\-party platforms differ in coverage.
* Working knowledge of the modern security toolset CNAPP/CSPM, EDR/XDR, SIEM, secrets management, privileged access management, SSE/CASB, WAF and perimeter protection, database activity monitoring, and SAST/SCA/DAST in the pipeline.
* AI security: familiarity with AI and LLM threat models (such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications), AI governance frameworks (such as the NIST AI Risk Management Framework), AI security posture management, model and agent identity, and the data\-security implications of AI adoption.
Pragmatic understanding of security problems as a mix of technology and process, with the ability to pursue solutions at multiple levels throughout the organisation.  
* 

  

**Leadership and communication**
--------------------------------

* Expert presentation and communication skills, written and verbal.
* People leadership experience preferred, including the ability to engage, mentor, coach and develop.
* Extensive knowledge of information security principles, best practices and industry standards.
Self\-starter, strategic thinker, negotiator and consensus builder.  
* 

**Education**

* University degree/college diploma in related discipline(s) or equivalent co\-op work experience,
Professional designation in IT security (such as CISM, CISSP, CISA) preferred  
* 

  

**What's in it for you?**

  

* A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
* A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
* Time off that allows you to focus on the moments that matter most. 20 vacation days p

jobs.title: AVP, Delivery Excellence & Transformation
jobs.description:
The AVP, Delivery Excellence \& Transformation sets the strategy for how Technology plans, resources and delivers work, bringing together program and project management, Agile practices and AI\-enabled transformation to improve predictability and business outcomes. The role aligns quarterly delivery planning with enterprise planning, funding and governance. Accountabilities span development of delivery leaders and professionals, and ownership of delivery platforms, workforce planning, internal and external resource allocation, and strategic staffing and delivery partnerships.

  

  

The AVP leads enterprise\-wide delivery transformation, defining and implementing an AI\-enabled delivery model that simplifies processes, redefines roles and controls, and embeds new ways of working. The mandate is to remove unnecessary complexity and deliver measurable business outcomes through effective AI adoption.

  

  

**What you will do:**

* Lead program and project management, Scrum Master and Agile Coaching practices, setting standards and driving continuous improvement across traditional and Agile delivery.
* Develop delivery leaders and professionals through career pathways, coaching and practical AI skills.
* Align quarterly delivery planning, including PI Planning and Big Room Planning, with enterprise priorities, funding and governance; partner with platform leaders to address dependencies, readiness gaps and prioritization decisions. Partner with business, technology and corporate leaders to clarify accountabilities and align delivery practices with enterprise requirements.
* Lead enterprise\-wide adoption of the AI\-enabled delivery model, challenging established practices, eliminating low\-value work and simplifying processes, roles and controls; build commitment to change and align adoption with enterprise standards.
* Own delivery tools for project and resource tracking, ensuring reliable data and integrated, automated reporting.
* Establish delivery performance measures and validate AI benefits against baselines, using evidence to guide improvement and investment decisions.
* Own Technology workforce planning, talent intake and internal and external resource allocation, aligning skills and capacity with funded demand.
* Manage Engineering operating expense forecasts and savings commitments, translating realized productivity gains into workforce and sourcing decisions.
* Manage strategic staffing and delivery partnerships, setting contractual expectations for quality, productivity, AI adoption and security; work with Procurement, Legal and Architecture on commercial terms and remediation.
* Challenge the status quo, remove unnecessary complexity and focus on outcomes over process.
* Develop people, build commitment to change and lead effective AI adoption.
* Exercise sound financial judgment and hold teams and partners accountable for measurable business results.
  

**What you will bring:**

* Experience leading Program and Project Management and Agile delivery practices in a complex enterprise, developing leaders and professionals, and driving continuous improvement across traditional and Agile approaches.
* Expertise in enterprise and quarterly delivery planning, including aligning priorities, funding, capacity and dependencies; sound judgment in applying project management, SAFe, Scrum and Lean practices to business needs.
* Demonstrated success redesigning processes, roles and controls through AI and automation, with practical knowledge of generative and agentic AI adoption and evidence of measurable benefits beyond tool deployment.
* Strong workforce planning, resource allocation and financial acumen, including operating expense forecasting, savings realization and management of internal and external technology capacity.
* Experience managing strategic technology staffing and delivery partnerships, including sourcing, commercial negotiations, contractual expectations and partner performance.
* Experience owning delivery\-platform requirements and adoption, establishing reliable data and performance measures, and validating productivity and delivery improvements against baselines.
* Proven experience leading enterprise\-wide transformation, with strong executive communication and cross\-functional influence to build commitment, navigate resistance and sustain adoption. A change\-oriented mindset and strong bias for simplifying complexity, challenging the status quo and delivering measurable business outcomes.

Canadian Tire Corporation, Limited (“CTC”) is one of Canada’s most admired and trusted companies. jobs.description:
**ABOUT THE FOUNDATION**

At the St. Joseph’s Health Centre Foundation we are committed to continuing to transform St. Joe’s as a leading community hospital that delivers the best care experiences to Toronto’s west end. We are guided by our mission to inspire philanthropy from our community and raise the funds needed to support that transformation.


St. Joe’s has provided care for millions of people in Toronto’s west end for more than a century. Today it is one Canada’s busiest community teaching hospitals, looking after a vibrant community of over half a million.


The Foundation has grown in recent years to be a leading community hospital foundation with a strong and engaged board of directors. We are looking for a new team member to help with gift management and donor engagement that helps to deliver the best care possible for our community.

The Director, Finance, Data \& Analytics provides strategic and operational leadership across financial management, business intelligence, fundraising analytics and organizational performance for the Foundation.


As the Foundation enters an ambitious next phase of campaign growth, this role will be responsible for ensuring that the organization has the financial discipline, data infrastructure and insights required to support informed decision\-making and maximize fundraising performance.

The Director will be the Foundation’s lead resource for financial reporting, fundraising analytics, campaign intelligence, data quality and performance reporting, ensuring that leaders have the information they need to identify opportunities, manage risk, allocate resources and achieve campaign objectives.

* Establish appropriate data governance, privacy, security and access practices in partnership with organizational leadership.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Finance Shared Services
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**  

The Senior Director, Finance Shared Services will have Canadian national responsibility for driving and managing all aspects of the Accounts Payable, Payroll, Accounts Receivable and Trade spend finance functions, including managing all relevant internal and external stakeholder relations as well as serving as a strategic partner to the Chief Financial Officer. The Senior Director Finance shared services provides counsel and strategic direction on related processes, governance and controls, and is responsible for service\-level delivery including timeliness and accuracy.
  
  

They will play a key role in establishing the financial strategy to drive operational efficiency and enterprise value; through standardization of processes, service delivery, controls and compliance and other continuous improvement opportunities. They will work in partnership with the Chief Financial Officer and the business stakeholders to drive continued growth and attain the company’s strategic goals, as well as providing proactive support to leadership throughout the business. The successful candidate must be able to succinctly articulate the value proposition for the business, while driving process optimization and cost efficiency for the internal finance function, as well as for the business.
  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**  

Accounting and Financial Reporting
  
* Establish, evaluate, and improve policies and procedures for effectiveness; implement changes to improve department performance and alignment with Company’s growth.
* Oversee preparation of relevant daily, weekly monthly, quarterly and year\-end financial reports.
* Review month\-end closing activities related to AP, payroll and AR and Trade Spend including subledger maintenance and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Serve as a key point of contact for AP, payroll, AR and trade spend inquiries from external auditors as needed.
* Manage shared services budget and operating costs.
* Ensure data integrity, reporting accuracy, and system effectiveness.


Service Delivery Excellence
  
* Lead the delivery of all shared services activities in cost efficient manner, while meeting agreed service levels.
* Ensure Services are delivered accurately, efficiently, and consistent across the organization
* Establish and monitor service levels and KPIs and customer satisfaction metrics.


Process Standardization and Continuous Improvement
  
* Design, implement and continuously improve standardized end to end processes including process automation and process simplification initiatives.
* Identify and eliminate inefficiencies, duplication, waste and non\-value added activities
* Benchmark performance against industry best practices.


Business Partnership and Customer Experience
  
* Act as strategic partner to business leaders and functional executives
* Develop strong relationships with internal stakeholders to understand needs and priorities


Governance, Controls and Compliance
  
* Develop and maintain internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory, legal, audit, and corporate policy requirements.


Strategy and Executive Management
  
* Develop and execute the shared services strategy and roadmap
* Champion and lead organizational and process change initiatives.


**Requirements:**  

* Shared Services professional with at least 10 years of increasingly responsible management experience.
* The ideal candidate will have led the Finance Shared Services function for a business with similar size and complexity.
* Strategic, “business\-driven” finance instincts and business acumen.
* Equally capable on both strategic and operational levels.
* Must have a strong track record of having built, implemented and continuously improved shared services processes and systems to drive synergies, savings, and/or improved controls
* Experience with integrating and implementing automation tools or information technology systems.
* Early career foundation in accounting and control.
* MBA and/or CPA an asset.


**Job Posting Range:**  

* Hiring Range: CAD $120,100 \- $170,100
* Bonus: This position is eligible for a bonus up to 17\.5% of base salary subject to the plan terms and conditions.
* Please note that the expected hiring range provided is derived from a group of like roles within Sofina. The final offer amount for this role will be dependent on geographical region, applicable experience, skillset of the candidate and internal equity.

jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Procurement and Third-Party Management
jobs.description:
At Equitable, we believe work should be a place where you feel supported, inspired, and empowered to grow. In our caring and collaborative environment, your curiosity is encouraged, your passion is recognized, and your contributions truly matter. Together, we create meaningful impact, for our clients, our communities, and each other.
  
  

**​​The Opportunity:**  ​ At Equitable, we believe great things happen when we work together. We’re a Canadian mutual company driven by purpose \- putting people first and helping Canadians protect today and prepare for tomorrow. If you’re passionate about making a difference and growing your career in an inclusive and collaborative environment, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  

Our culture is built on care, passion and curiosity. We put people above all else, strive to be our best and welcome new ideas to deliver positive outcomes.
  
  

As Director, Enterprise Third\-Party Management, you will lead the development and oversight of Equitable’s enterprise\-wide third\-party management framework, ensuring third\-party relationships deliver value, support strategic objectives, and operate within the Company's risk appetite and regulatory requirements. In this highly visible leadership role, you will oversee third\-party governance, procurement, vendor management, and cost optimization initiatives while ensuring compliance with OSFI Guideline B\-10 and other applicable regulations. Working closely with senior leaders across the organization, you will provide expert guidance on third\-party strategy, risk management, commercial relationships, and operational resilience. You will also lead a high\-performing team and help strengthen Equitable’s ability to manage third\-party risk while driving business performance and operational efficiency.
  
  

Join one of the region’s top employers and be part of something that truly makes a difference.
  
  

**Work Arrangements:** This is a hybrid role. You will work in our office in Waterloo, ON a minimum of two (2\) assigned, consecutive days every other week, plus a fifth (5th) assigned day per month.
